Fuel market attack | Regime shelling kills three persons, north of Idlib

SOHR activists have documented that at least three people were killed in shelling carried out by the regime forces on Wednesday morning on a fuel market of Watad petrol company and its surroundings in Termanin area in the northern Idlib countryside. The number of deaths is likely to rise because some people have been seriously injured. Regime shelling has also caused a huge fire at a camp.

SOHR activists have just reported rocket fires carried out by regime forces on the fuel market of ” Watad Petrol Fuel Company” in the vicinity of Termanin town in the northern Idlib countryside, where a widow’s camp is also located in the vicinity of the market. Plumes of smoke have been seen rising there, amid reported of casualties.
